measurement_note: Size is n, the number of cities. Each tier partitions the cities into disjoint stars of increasing sizes, producing linearly many roads and a varied degree multiset. Degree counting plus sorting takes O(n log n + r) time with r = O(n). Correctly finding and removing the smallest remaining degree for each assigned value completes all tiers and fails through O(n^2) scaling.
